stations.name: Mei
stations.question: This is Mei. What time does she get up?
stations.spoken: She gets up at six thirty.
extended: Her alarm clock rings at 6:30.
She brushes her teeth and puts on her school uniform.
Then she has breakfast at 6:45.

stations.name: Haruto
stations.question: This is Haruto. What time does he take a shower?
stations.spoken: He takes a shower at eight twenty.
extended: First, he washes in the shower.
Then he sits in the hot bath. It's called ofuro.
He goes to bed at 9:00.

stations.name: Emma
stations.question: This is Emma. What time does she have lunch?
stations.spoken: She has lunch at eleven thirty.
extended: She eats lunch in the school cafeteria.
She has a sandwich, an apple and milk.
Lunch is only 25 minutes!

stations.name: Oliver
stations.question: This is Oliver. What time does he go home?
stations.spoken: He goes home at three fifteen.
extended: School ends at 3:15.
His dad walks him home.
He has a snack, and then he does his homework.

stations.name: Lucia
stations.question: This is Lucia. What time does she have lunch?
stations.spoken: She has lunch at two o'clock.
extended: Lunch is her big meal. She eats soup, fish and fruit with her family.
Then she rests for a while.

stations.name: Omar
stations.question: This is Omar. What time does he go to school?
stations.spoken: He goes to school at seven ten.
extended: School starts at 7:30.
He walks to school with his big sister.
He carries his school bag on his back.

stations.name: Amani
stations.question: This is Amani. What time does she have dinner?
stations.spoken: She has dinner at seven thirty.
extended: Her family eats dinner together.
She eats ugali and sukuma wiki.
Ugali is made from white corn flour.

stations.name: Arjun
stations.question: This is Arjun. What time does he play cricket?
stations.spoken: He plays cricket at five o'clock.
extended: He plays cricket with his friends in the street.
A school bag is the wicket!
He goes home at 6:30.

stations.name: Ling
stations.question: This is Ling. What time does she study English?
stations.spoken: She studies English at four o'clock.
extended: She goes to an English class after school.
She reads a story and writes new words.
She goes home at 6:00.

stations.name: Jack
stations.question: This is Jack. What time does he do his homework?
stations.spoken: He does his homework at four forty-five.
extended: He plays soccer after school.
Then he does his homework at the kitchen table.
It takes 20 minutes.
